added.name: Orca Aerospace
added.long_description: At Orca, we are focused on creating the future of spacecraft operations by moving control onto the vehicle. By allowing LLMs to control the satellite using deterministic tooling, we are able to achieve the same holistic, high-quality decisions on "what" to do to carry out a mission while maintaining the safety of systems that decide "how" to execute it.
added.one_liner: AI spacecraft operator that lives onboard the vehicle.

removed.name: Incandor
removed.long_description: Incandor detects fraud on banking and fintech platforms by learning how every user physically behaves — mouse dynamics, keystroke timing, scroll patterns, and on mobile, how they hold their phone. Founded by two Stanford engineers and backed by Y Combinator, Incandor builds a behavioral map of every user on your platform — no fraud labels or historical data required. At the individual level, it identifies account takeovers with >99% accuracy. At the population level, coordinated rings, mule operators, and coerced sessions separate out naturally. Rather than a black-box risk score, fraud teams query the map via a programmable API.

one_liner.before: How great teams ship with AI

long_description.before:
Healthcare employers tell Adni who they're hiring. Adni searches millions of healthcare workers across its own clinician network, proprietary data, external sources, and employer databases to identify the best candidates.

Recruiters can search and contact candidates themselves, or deploy Allie, Adni's AI recruiting agent, to continuously source, screen, and surface interested candidates automatically.

Unlike traditional recruiting databases, Adni operates a career community where healthcare workers find jobs, connect with peers, attend meetups, review facilities, and manage their careers. This gives Adni a growing proprietary network of engaged clinicians and real-time signals on who is looking for work and what they want.

Backed by YC, Flare Capital, Liquid 2, Fresco, Augment, Crista Galli, Adam Grant, and the founders of CareRev, Clipboard Health, Papa, and more.
long_description.after:

Organizations partner with Adni to reach and hire healthcare workers through our network, a verified database of 2.4M clinicians, and AI-powered marketing tools. Customers have received 67,000+ clinician leads and acquire clinicians at 3x lower cost.

long_description.before: Findly.ai is the co-pilot for Business Intelligence that revolutionizes how businesses understand and interact with their data. By creating an engaging chat environment, it empowers decision-makers to gain insights, request reports, and generate visualizations based on their company's metrics. This seamless interaction is made possible by integrating a metric layer that comprehends all your company's metrics. The chat-based exploration simplifies complex data analysis, allowing users to generate comprehensive summaries with a single click, which can be exported to various formats. Furthermore, with the introduction of scheduled chats and action-triggered automations, Findly.ai enhances the autonomy and efficiency of decision-makers. It's more than a tool; it's a decision-making operational system aiming to facilitate decision-makers in achieving their KPIs while spending less time waiting for data.
long_description.after:
Ad Army is an AI creative tool for brands that need a constant supply of ad creative.

You build your brand's world once — characters, products, locations — each with locked descriptors and reference images. Then you generate against it: @-mention an entity in a prompt and its references are pulled into the model call, so the same product, the same face and the same location hold across images, video, and dozens of variants. Save any chain of steps as a recipe and replay it on the next campaign.

We're model-agnostic by design — video, image, text and audio providers sit behind one interface, and new models land as they ship. For a full narrative spot, the same world scripts, storyboards, animates, voices, captions and exports multi-scene ads in every aspect ratio.

one_liner.after: Generate, iterate, and ship AI ad creatives faster

long_description.before:
Depot is a build acceleration platform making builds up to 40x faster for Docker containers and GitHub Actions. Companies like PostHog, Wistia, Appsmith, and Secoda use Depot to save tens of hours of build time every day.

We offer a remote container build service for building Intel & Arm Docker images, from your CI or local machine, up to 40x faster. Our container builds come with in-depth build insights, ephemeral registries, and instant cache sharing across your team.

Finally, we also offer our own Depot GitHub Actions Runners that brings all the speed of Depot to your entire GitHub Actions workflow at half the cost of GitHub-hosted runners, and up to 10x faster builds. Simply change the runs-on label of your existing workflow to route jobs to Depot runners.

Kyle and Jacob worked together as staff engineers for 4.5 years at Thorn and Era Software, before founding Depot. Depot is their solution to the wildly inefficient container build tooling and non-performant CI systems they encountered throughout their careers.
long_description.after:
Depot gives engineering teams the fast source control, builds, CI runners, sandboxes, caches, and registries they need to ship reliable software they trust at AI speed. Companies like PostHog, Inference, Wistia, PlanetScale, Poolside, Astral, and Semgrep use Depot to power their entire software delivery stack.

Kyle and Jacob worked together as staff engineers for 4.5 years at Thorn and Era Software, before founding Depot. Depot is their take on what software delivery and a replacement for GitHub could look like in the world of AI.

RiskCube fixes that: we compare 40+ AM Best-rated U.S. carriers, pair that with licensed human broker review, and bind the right coverage and issue your COI within a day, not weeks. Founders get D&O, Tech E&O, Cyber, General Liability, Product Liability, Key Person Life, and COIs — to pass procurement, satisfy investors, and close deals. RiskCube is an independent broker, not an insurance carrier, built for AI, Space and Defense, and government-contractor startups. Licensed in CA, TX, and DE (expanding nationwide).

Companies today are growing faster than ever with smaller teams. We are making it possible for these lean, AI-native companies to manage enterprise deals.

Every $1-5M of new revenue requires another CSM hire. Userlens breaks that ceiling. Our agents research accounts, catch churn before it happens, and drive renewals and upsells like a top-tier CSM would. 

We're at $307K ARR, growing 127% month over month, with 30 customers including Smartly (300M ARR). Over 300 CSMs are on Userlens, and 76% of them use it weekly. 

Built by second-time founders who lived this problem at their last startup.

Companies today are growing faster than ever with smaller teams. The best AI-native companies don’t just need more users - they need more of their users becoming power users. Userlens makes it possible for lean teams to drive product adoption proactively, at scale.

Userlens is building the AI product adoption expert. Our goal is to help every user at every company get more value from the product they already use.
